entries.1f1a687e56460185: Its management philosophy is: 'The company's reason for being is to serve as a bridge between producers and consumers. We achieve stable procurement and supply of rice, support the food infrastructure, and protect Japan's food culture.' Its new medium-term management plan (2026–2028) sets out 'Step Up,' aimed at a 'Stage Change,' and aims to evolve from a rice wholesaler into a company that serves as infrastructure for rice-based diets. As a long-term vision, it has set a target to be achieved by 2040.
